description.en: Just point this infrared remote at your DIRECTV® system and click to operate all your components. Change channels, fast-forward, adjust volume, and more.n
No need to point. With this radio frequency-capable remote, you can change channels, fast-forward and adjust volume even on TV systems in other rooms.n

If your receiver is not Radio Frequency (RF) capable, don't worry. All you need is a DIRECTV RF Remote and an external RF Antenna to control your DIRECTV® system without even pointing your remote at it.n

With this streamlined remote, it's now easier than ever to control your entertainment. It's smaller than our standard remote and has a significantly faster response time. Compatible with Genie HD DVR in RF and IR mode-and all other receivers when in IR mode.n

This wireless kit includes everything you need to connect your HD DVR to your existing high-speed Internet network. Please note: Your home must be equipped with active high-speed Internet service and a wireless router.n

attributes.productHighlights:
A Radio Frequency (RF) Remote allows you to control your DIRECTV® System without directly pointing at it.
In order for it to work, your DIRECTV receiver has to be equipped with a built-in RF Antenna.
If you have an older model receiver that's not RF-capable, you'll need an external RF Antenna.n
